procedural.content: Optimization success: Replaced correlated subqueries with CTEs and window functions. Original query timed out after 120s. Optimized query using ROW_NUMBER() window function to rank synsets completed in 1.4s - approximately 85x faster. Key technique: Pre-compute synset rankings once per word using PARTITION BY instead of executing nested subqueries for each result row.
